items.title: Scaling security with responsible disclosure
items.summary: OpenAI introduces its Outbound Coordinated Disclosure Policy to guide how it responsibly reports vulnerabilities in third-party software—emphasizing integrity, collaboration, and proactive security at scale.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出了“出站协调披露政策”（Outbound Coordinated Disclosure Policy），旨在规范其报告第三方软件漏洞的流程。该政策强调了在发现安全隐患时，通过协作与透明的方式进行负责任的披露，以提升整体生态系统的安全性。此举是OpenAI在AI安全治理与合规性方面的重要举措，旨在通过标准化流程减少安全风险。
